One of `trace`, `verbose`, `info`, `warn`, `error`.<br /> Determines how much info is being logged to the console.<br /><br /> Default `info`.

## CLI flag

Use `--log` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                         | Flag            |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                           | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                           | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                             | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)               | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)                           | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion browser ensure`](/docs/cli/browser/ensure)           | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                     | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion versions`](/docs/cli/versions)                       | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion upgrade`](/docs/cli/upgrade)                         | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion add`](/docs/cli/add)                                 | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)                                 | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)             | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)               | `--log <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions) | `--log <value>` |
